name: mibi-adult-S02-a
refs: The adult of this species (project-owned rig render): its body plan and proportions only, a crude 3D blockout to be painted over: a large round body under a broad flat cap, with a round tail puff behind. Its blockout colours are not the creature's colours.
The species' signed silhouette (project-owned): the adult's outline.
prompt: Paint the ADULT of the creature in the references: a large round bean-shaped body in a warm medium brown, wearing a flat rounded cap of pale tan on top of its head like a mushroom cap, with a small round brown tail puff behind. Keep its body plan and proportions, but NOT the blockout's geometry or colours. It has a FACE on the front of the body just under the cap: two round dark glossy eyes with a pale highlight, soft rosy cheeks, a small calm mouth. This is the species' BARE BASE picture: the cap is SMALL and neat, NO spots, NO bands, NO flecks on the body, the coat smooth with only a short soft fuzz. Soft, rounded, living forms; short stubby feet barely showing under the body. Matte painterly rendering like a children's book, smooth painted forms, gentle shading, light from the top left, a soft flat contact shadow beneath it. Three-quarter view from the front left, facing the viewer, calm, at rest. One creature, centred, large, on a plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with nothing else. No outline glow, no text, no ground, no props, no people.
